newsitem.title: USA: US stocks move higher as bonds gain.
newsitem.headline: US stocks move higher as bonds gain.

text.p: U.S. stocks firmed in early trading on Monday morning as bonds gained, with the Dow Industrials firming after a slightly negative opening and most major indexes posting gains.
The Dow Industrials were up about 10 to 6,494 and the long bond rose 8/32 to yield 6.59 percent.
The Standard & Poor's 500 Index was up about 1 to 750. The Nasdaq Composite was up one to 1289.58.
